description_en: Queries Resource Access Management (RAM) users in a RAM user group
description_zh: 调用ListUsersForGroup接口列出指定用户组所包含的RAM用户
kebab_example: aliyun ram list-users-for-group --group-name Dev-Team --marker EXAMPLE --max-items 100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUsersForGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM user group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The `marker`. If part of a previous response is truncated, you can use this parameter to obtain the truncated part
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，可以使用`Marker`获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return. If a response is truncated because it reaches the value of `MaxItems`, the value of `IsTruncated` will be `true`.

Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果的条数。当返回结果达到`MaxItems`限制被截断时，返回参数`IsTruncated`将等于`true`。

取值范围：1 ~ 1000，默认值：100
parameters.name: max_items

IsTruncated.description_en: Indicates whether the response is truncated
IsTruncated.description_zh: 请求返回结果是否被截断

Marker.description_en: The marker. This parameter is returned only if the value of `IsTruncated` is `true`. If the parameter is returned, you can call this operation again and set this parameter to obtain the truncated part.\`\`\`\`
Marker.description_zh: 当`IsTruncated`为`true`时才有此字段。当返回`true`时，需要继续调用此接口，并且使用`Marker`获取截断后的内容

User.description_en: The information about the RAM users

items.description_en: The information about the RAM user

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the RAM user

JoinDate.description_en: The time when the RAM user joined the RAM user group

UserName.description_en: The name of the RAM user
